label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll rose steadily from 2 (15 Aug) to 73 (19 Aug) to 83 (21 Aug, 16:00 WIB) as rescue teams reached remote villages; BNPB says the 8 newest deaths (Manggarai 2, East Manggarai 2, Nagekeo 3, Ngada 1) are indirect earthquake impacts (shock, falls, aftershock-triggered cardiac events) rather than structural-collapse fatalities.

label: Injured
contestNote: BNPB's 21 August 16:00 WIB tally cites 986 injured, revised down from the 1,182 figure reported on 19 August as regency-level counts were reconciled; both figures have appeared in reporting.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: Figures climbed from 12,800 (17 Aug) to 40,000+ (19 Aug) to 92,735 (20 Aug) to 110,785 (21 Aug, 16:00 WIB) as assessments reached isolated communities; Xinhua's 21 Aug wire separately cited 'nearly 100,000' displaced.

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BPBD NTT's 21 August tally of 44,946 (17,176 severe, 9,758 moderate, 18,013 slight) supersedes the 19,297 figure reported two days earlier; Manggarai, East Manggarai and West Manggarai regencies account for the largest share.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M1.1–M6.2 range, 118 felt by residents; BMKG predicts continued activity for 21–30 more days from the mainshock.

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.
